== Source-face capitalisation and artwork check ==
The retained original, printed E and printed E1 faces all print uppercase “If”. The earlier lowercase transcription and corresponding fragmented case-change comparison were corrected. The E1 face replaces the blue hologram artwork with a different darker Snoke image.<ref>Retained actual published card faces: [[:File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-08.gif]] (original), [[:File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader-2018-07-09.gif]] (printed E) and [[:File:V7-D-specterofthesupremeleader.gif]] (printed E1).</ref>
The complete Set 7 PDFs captured in 2021 and printed September 2023 were also inspected as composed sources. This bounded correction does not assert an additional ordinal from their rendering, image resolution or outer padding, and does not assign a new executable ID. Exact whole-face layout equivalence remains a separate source-audit question.
